assembly.title: Service Scheduling LogicalAssembly
assembly.description: The minimum operational meaning required to schedule a confirmed routine-maintenance appointment.

concepts.name: Customer consent
concepts.description: The customer's explicit approval of a proposed appointment time.

concepts.name: Vehicle eligibility
concepts.description: Whether the vehicle and requested service can be handled by the selected location.

concepts.name: Appointment slot
concepts.description: An available service time satisfying the requested scheduling window.

concepts.name: Service appointment
concepts.description: A committed service visit for an eligible vehicle at a confirmed time.

relations.name: Appointment requires eligibility
relations.description: A service appointment may be created only for an eligible vehicle.

constraints.name: Confirm before booking
constraints.description: A customer appointment cannot be committed until the customer confirms the proposed time.
constraints.rule: customer consent must be confirmed before appointment creation

constraints.name: Eligible requested window
constraints.description: The chosen slot must satisfy vehicle eligibility and the requested scheduling window.
constraints.rule: slot must be eligible and within the requested window

events.name: Appointment created
events.description: A confirmed appointment becomes committed in the scheduling system.

policies.name: Scheduling eligibility policy
policies.description: Commit only eligible appointments that match the requested window and have customer confirmation.
policies.commitment: create an appointment only after eligibility and customer confirmation are established

evaluations.name: Scheduling gate
evaluations.description: Checks eligibility, requested-window fit, and customer confirmation before appointment creation.
